title: Water shut-off on Tuesday
text: The water at Elm Court will be off on Tuesday from 9 am to noon while the plumbers replace a main valve. Please fill a jug the night before.

title: Pest control visit
text: Our pest control partner visits Riverside Lofts on the first Monday of the month. No need to be home; the technician treats common areas and units that asked for it.

title: Office hours over the holidays
text: The office closes at 1 pm on November 26 and stays closed on November 27. For emergencies, call the main number and choose option 1.
